visualCharacteristics.purpose: Collapsed legal disclaimer toggle, usually at the bottom of the page, that expands to show fine print

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: cell 1 is the toggle label; optional cell 2 is a summary that stays visible under the toggle when more rows follow (or the disclaimer body when it is the only row). Rows 2+: disclaimer body content (paragraphs, lists, footnotes), hidden until opened

reuseGuidance: Use once per page for legal disclaimers / footnotes. For question-and-answer lists use accordion-faq.
